ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, two horizontal lines mark out a latitude belt; on the right side, 60° is labeled above and 30° is labeled below, indicating that the shown range is the mid-latitude belt between 30°—60°; within this latitude belt, multiple arrows indicating prevailing wind directions are drawn. Then reason: the planetary wind belt corresponding to the 30°—60° mid-latitude region is mainly the westerly belt. The question stem limits it to the “west coast of a continent” and “under the year-round influence of the prevailing winds of this latitude belt,” indicating that the westerlies blow from the ocean toward the west coast of the continent for a long time, bringing mild and humid maritime airflows, so the typical climate type formed is temperate oceanic climate.

method.method_draft: 根据图像先确定所示纬度带是30°—60°的中纬度带，再识别该带的盛行风属于西风带。结合题干限定“大陆西岸、长年受该纬度带盛行风影响”，判断西风从海洋吹向大陆西岸，带来全年温和湿润的海洋性影响，因此气候类型为温带海洋性气候。
